name: LMR33630
description: 36 V, 3 A synchronous buck with power-good, 25 µA quiescent current and internal compensation, for 24 V robots and 6S–8S LiPo packs.
notes: Frequency is fixed by the part number: A = 400 kHz, B = 1.4 MHz, C = 2.1 MHz.
1 V reference, so the output can't go below 1 V.
Two VIN and two PGND pins: place input caps on both sides.

en.note: Pin table: 'Can be connected directly to VIN; do not float.' EN abs max is VIN + 0.3 V (VIN abs max 38 V). Precision enable: VEN-H 1.231 V typ rising (1.2-1.26), 100 mV hysteresis; above VEN-VCC-H (1 V) the VCC LDO turns on (standby), below VEN-VCC-L (0.3 V) full shutdown. Optional UVLO divider (Eq. 10): pick RENB 10-100 kΩ, RENT = (VON/VEN-H - 1)*RENB, VOFF = VON*(1 - VEN-HYS/VEN-H).

pg.note: Open-drain NMOS. Pull up to a logic rail, or to VCC or VOUT through 100 kΩ (sec. 8.3.1 / 9.2.2.8). Recommended max 18 V and never more than VIN + 0.3 V. Leave floating if unused. Low below 92 % (falling) / high above 94 % (rising) of VFB; over-voltage trip 107 %/105 %. ~4 ms PG delay at start-up, 60-170 µs glitch filter. Keep DC sink current < 5 mA. Forced low when EN is low (valid down to VIN = 2 V).

extras.note: Internal 5 V LDO output; requires a high-quality 1 µF, 16 V ceramic to GND. Do not load (a PG pull-up is OK) and never short it.

notes: Peak-current-mode, internally compensated. Frequency is fixed by the variant: A = 400 kHz (340-460), B = 1.4 MHz, C = 2.1 MHz. Auto PFM/PWM (diode emulation at light load), 4 ms internal soft start (2.9-6 ms), hiccup if FB < 0.4 V in current limit (94 ms off).

Timing (DDA/HSOIC): tON-MIN 75 ns typ (108 max), tOFF-MIN 50 ns typ (85 max); RNX/VQFN 68 / 52 ns. Frequency folds back when tON-MIN is reached (onset VIN ~ VOUT/(tON*fSW)) and in dropout, down to ~140 kHz. DMAX 98 % (system spec, in dropout).
Current limits: high-side ISC 4.5 A typ (3.85-5.05), low-side valley ILIMIT 3.5 A typ (2.9-4.1); IOUT(max) ~ (ILIMIT + ISC)/2 (Eq. 1).

Inductor (Eq. 4): L = (VIN - VOUT)/(fSW*K*IOUTmax) * VOUT/VIN with K = 0.2-0.4 (0.3 best). Use the device max current (3 A) for IOUTmax even if the load is smaller. Minimum L (Eq. 5): LMIN >= 0.28*VOUT/fSW (H, Hz), i.e. ripple >= ~10 % of rated current. Isat should be >= ISC; never below ILIMIT.

Output caps: ceramic X5R or better, effective values. COUT >= dIOUT/(fSW*dVOUT*K) * [(1-D)*(1+K) + K^2/12*(2-D)]; ESR <= (2+K)*dVOUT / (2*dIOUT*[1 + K + K^2/12*(1 + 1/(1-D))]); D = VOUT/VIN (Eq. 6). Ripple Vr ~ dIL*sqrt(ESR^2 + 1/(8*fSW*COUT)^2) (Eq. 7). Total COUT max ~10x the design value or 1000 µF, whichever is smaller. Use >= 10 V caps for VOUT <= 3.3 V, >= 16 V for VOUT >= 5 V. A 1-100 nF small ceramic on VOUT helps HF spikes.

Feedback: RFBT 100 kΩ recommended (max 1 MΩ), RFBB = RFBT/(VOUT/VREF - 1) (Eq. 3). If RFBT = 1 MΩ a CFF is mandatory. CFF is 'open' in all of Table 9-2, so it is optional; starting value from Eq. 9: CFF < VOUT*COUT / (120*RFBT*sqrt(VREF/VOUT)), then try smaller values.

Input: >= 10 µF ceramic required, rated >= max VIN (preferably 2x), plus a small-case 220 nF X7R as close as possible to VIN/PGND (mandatory HF bypass). IRMS ~ IOUT/2. Add a 20-100 µF electrolytic if supply leads are long.
Table 9-2 (1.4 MHz B version): 3.3 V -> 2.2 µH, 2x22 µF; 5 V -> 2.2 µH, 2x22 µF; 12 V -> 4.7 µH, 4x10 µF (same RFBT/RFBB, 10 µF + 220 nF in, 100 nF boot, 1 µF VCC, CFF open).
Do not let VOUT exceed VIN or go below ground. Layout: input cap loop as small as possible; CBOOT and CVCC close; FB divider close to FB pin.
Catalog check: VIN 3.8-36 V, VOUT 1-24 V (rec. op.; footnote says up to 95 % of VIN on request, TI product page lists 34 V max), 3 A, 400 kHz for the A version all agree with the datasheet.
